parsed.justification: Rationale A correctly identifies the weakness in grounding (lague of precise section identification) but does not explicitly map this to the rubric's categories. It somewhat hedges between score categories. Rationale B correctly applies the rubric, distinguishing between the two parts of the comment, noting the first part's ambiguity and the second part's specificity about missing discussion of limitations. It maps clearly to score 3 (weakly grounded but specific about what needs addressing), which aligns with the rubric criteria. B is more precise in its rubric application and evidence grounding.
